title: Stage 6 — Insights Readout Narrative (Companion Artifact)
description: Narrative companion to the helper-classified 06-readout.json. Authored by stage-6-insights-readout-agent. The agent does NOT classify and does NOT mutate 06-readout.json; it sources verdicts and observed numbers from the helper output and produces a stakeholder-voice narrative around them.

readout_helper_artifact_path.description: Path to the helper-emitted 06-readout.json that this narrative wraps. Helper retains classification authority.

preregistration_path.description: Path to the locked Stage 5a pre-registration artifact the helper measured against.

verdict_referenced_from_helper.description: Aggregate verdict mirrored from the helper output. The agent does not author this; it copies it. The two refusal states (needs_helper_clarification, needs_input_resolution) indicate the agent declined to author a narrative because helper output or inputs were inconsistent or missing.

per_cell_verdicts.description: Per-cell verdicts mirrored verbatim from the helper output. The agent never authors verdicts; it carries them.

narrative_md.description: Stakeholder-voice Markdown body. Must not contradict any per-cell verdict. Modeled-reporting caveat appears verbatim in the body.

citations.description: Every observed number cites the helper artifact; every threshold cites the pre-registration artifact. No free-floating numbers.

modeled_reporting_caveat_present.description: MUST be true for a valid run. The modeled-reporting caveat must appear verbatim in narrative_md and this flag must confirm presence.

refusal_reason.description: Populated only when verdict_referenced_from_helper is needs_helper_clarification or needs_input_resolution; names the inconsistency or missing field that blocked narrative authoring.
